savePicker.timeControlHelp:
Standard PGN format (TimeControl tag):
300 = 5 min, sudden death
300+3 = 5 min + 3 s/move
40/5400 = 40 moves in 90 min
40/5400+30:1800+30 = 90 min for 40 moves (+30 s/move), then +30 min (+30 s/move) -- classical control with a 40th-move addition
- = untimed   ? = unknown
